_comment: Optional. Copy to memory/projects.json to group your facts into named projects.
Helix derives everything else about a fact from the file itself — its date, its stated
verdict, and which other facts it cites. The only thing it cannot guess is which project
a file belongs to, so that is the one thing you declare here.
'blueprint' drives the BLUEPRINT and MAP lenses: first keyword match wins, so order matters.
'memory'    drives the memory constellation: explicit file lists, anything unlisted -> MISC.
Delete this file entirely and everything simply lands in one GENERAL bucket.
